pune.name: Pune
pune.comment: Playable area: central Pune - Shivajinagar, Deccan, FC/JM Road, University Road, the Peths, Swargate, Pune Station, Parvati, Bibwewadi, Taljai hills and Kondhwa Budruk (Rathi Maheshwari Hostel).

special_buildings.name: RATHI MAHESHWARI HOSTEL
special_buildings.full_name: Seth Shri Gangadhar Bansilal Rathi Maheshwari Hostel (ABMECT)
special_buildings.source: Coordinates: kondhwa.in business directory (latitude also on Justdial); address Sai Nagar / Shatrunjay Nagar, Kondhwa Budruk, Pune 411048 (ABMECT). 4 storeys per hostel description. Footprint = nearest large OSM building (OSM has no name for it).
